targets.title: Mood state dissociates conflict adaptation within tasks and across tasks.
targets.outcome_quote: We did not replicate our previous finding of enhanced conflict adaptation in task switches in positive mood.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly reports failure to replicate the original positive-mood task-switch finding. It does not establish another original finding that was successfully replicated.

reasoning: New data directly replicate the 2018 paper.
